title: Kagerou
summary: The thief and all five natures.

lines: I brought shinobi. Give back the scroll, Kagerou.
The academy threw me out for being too strong. Now I'll have an army of me. Let's see who they throw out then.
That's the worst plan I've ever heard, and I make a lot of plans.
Fire, wind, lightning, earth, water. I carry all five now. Which will you answer with, little {nature} user?
{name}. Watch his chakra change. Answer each nature with the one that beats it.
Asahi and I will hold off his clones. He's yours.

phases.say: Earth. You can't break what doesn't move.
Water puts out every fire. Even yours.

lines: ...Five natures. And you still beat me.
You had five natures. I had the circle.
Take it. It never liked me anyway.
But the seal I cut from it stays with me. Until next time, Sensei.
He kept the last seal. What does that mean?
But tonight, {name}, you did what three jonin couldn't. Rest. Tomorrow your real training starts.
